mapper.select: select stock_id as stockId, location_id as locationId, qty_available as qtyAvailable from biz_stock where store_id = 1 and book_id = #{bookId} and qty_available > 0 order by qty_available desc, stock_id limit 1

select stock_id as stockId, location_id as locationId, qty_locked as qtyLocked, qty_available as qtyAvailable from biz_stock where store_id = 1 and book_id = #{bookId} and qty_locked > 0 order by qty_locked desc, stock_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_stock_flow (store_id, book_id, location_id, stock_type, biz_type, biz_no, qty_change, qty_before, qty_after, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{storeId}, #{bookId}, #{locationId}, #{stockType}, #{bizType}, #{bizNo}, #{qtyChange}, #{qtyBefore}, #{qtyAfter}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update biz_used_book set stock_status = 2, lock_order_id = #{orderId}, lock_time = now() where used_book_id = #{usedBookId} and stock_status = 1
update biz_used_book set stock_status = 1, lock_order_id = 0, lock_time = null where used_book_id = #{usedBookId} and stock_status = 2 and (lock_order_id = #{orderId} or lock_order_id = 0)
mapper.select: select o.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.status, case o.status when 1 then '待支付' when 2 then '已支付' when 3 then '待取货' when 4 then '已完成' when 5 then '已取消' when 6 then '退款中' else '已退款' end as statusLabel, o.pay_amount as payAmount, o.pickup_code as pickupCode, o.create_time as createTime, o.pay_expire_time as payExpireTime, (select count(*) from biz_order_item i where i.order_id = o.order_id) as itemCount from biz_order o where o.store_id = 1 and o.member_id = #{memberId} and o.status = #{status} order by o.order_id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select o.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.order_type as orderType, o.member_id as memberId, o.member_no as memberNo, o.member_name as memberName, o.member_level_id as memberLevelId, o.book_kind as bookKind, o.total_qty as totalQty, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.single_discount as singleDiscount, o.member_discount as memberDiscount, o.coupon_amount as couponAmount, o.point_amount as pointAmount, o.discount_total as discountTotal, o.pay_amount as payAmount, o.point_used as pointUsed, o.point_gain as pointGain, o.coupon_id as couponId, o.status, o.pay_expire_time as payExpireTime, o.pay_time as payTime, o.pickup_code as pickupCode, o.pickup_time as pickupTime, o.finish_time as finishTime, o.remark, o.create_time as createTime from biz_order o where o.order_id = #{orderId} and o.member_id = #{memberId} and o.store_id = 1

select item_id as itemId, order_id as orderId, book_id as bookId, used_book_id as usedBookId, isbn, title, book_type as bookType, condition_grade as conditionGrade, origin_price as originPrice, unit_price as unitPrice, qty, amount, single_discount as singleDiscount, member_discount as memberDiscount, coupon_share as couponShare, point_share as pointShare, share_amount as shareAmount from biz_order_item where order_id = #{orderId} order by item_id

select payment_id as paymentId, pay_no as payNo, pay_method as payMethod, pay_amount as payAmount, pay_status as payStatus, trade_no as tradeNo, pay_time as payTime, refund_amount as refundAmount, refund_time as refundTime from biz_payment where order_id = #{orderId} order by payment_id
select order_id as orderId from biz_order where store_id = 1 and status = 1 and pay_expire_time is not null and pay_expire_time < #{now} order by order_id limit 50
